story.title: 91 Nations Sign India's New Delhi AI Declaration — Delhi Reframes Global AI From Risk to Impact
story.summary: India hosted the global India AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, with delegations from over 100 countries, 20 international organisations, and 600,000 attendees. The summit's headline achievement: 91 countries and international organisations signed the New Delhi AI Declaration — shifting the global AI governance conversation from the 'risk' framing established in Bletchley and Paris to a new 'impact' framing focused on People, Planet, and Progress. India also set a Guinness World Record for the most pledges for an AI responsibility campaign in 24 hours: 250,946 participants. This positions India not just as an AI builder but as the country that is defining the ethical and policy framework for AI in the Global South.
